stalls.en: Yu Pin Yuan Ice & Fire Tangyuan
foodsEn: Osmanthus sesame tangyuan on shaved ice
stalls.where: 通化街 39 巷 50 弄 31 號
stalls.summaryZh: 熱湯圓放在刨冰上，淋桂花蜜和檸檬汁，冷熱交融是招牌；湯圓手工現做，建議趁熱吃。一年四季都排隊，米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Hot handmade tangyuan served on shaved ice with osmanthus honey and lemon juice. The hot-cold contrast is the draw, so eat it quickly before the tangyuan firm up. A line all year round. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

sources.title: 通化夜市美食推薦（GoFunIt，2026）

stalls.where: 通化街 39 巷 50 弄 33 號
stalls.summaryZh: 四十多種廣式乾滷味，拿籃子自己夾、再等叫號；價格平實但排隊很久，評價兩極。附的辣醬非常辣。
stalls.summaryEn: More than forty kinds of Cantonese-style dry braised snacks. Pick your items in a basket and wait for your number. Prices are fair, but waits are long and reviews are mixed. The chili sauce is very hot.

台北夜市米其林必比登攤位整理（風傳媒，2024）

stalls.where: 通化街 39 巷 50 弄 27 號
stalls.summaryZh: 菜單精簡，必點炒螺肉，火候好、鑊氣足，九層塔香；是排隊名店，曾連年獲必比登推薦。2026 年有網友反映份量變小。
stalls.summaryEn: A short menu. The must-order is stir-fried sea snail, cooked with good wok heat and plenty of basil. A famous queue spot that won Bib Gourmand for several years. In 2026 some diners said the portions have shrunk.

sources.title: 通化臨江街夜市16家美食（食尚玩家，2026）
通化夜市15間美食（蕃新聞旅遊，2024）
通化夜市美食推薦（GoFunIt，2026）

stalls.summaryZh: 配菜超過 50 種可自選，蔬菜新鮮、調味入味不死鹹，喜歡重口味可選麻辣；常排隊，可掃碼點餐縮短等待。
stalls.summaryEn: Choose from over 50 side items. The vegetables are fresh and well seasoned without being too salty, and there is a spicy version for bold tastes. Often a line, but QR ordering cuts the wait.

通化臨江街夜市16家美食（食尚玩家，2026）
通化夜市15間美食（蕃新聞旅遊，2024）

stalls.summaryZh: 芋圓尺寸是一般的好幾倍，外軟內Q、芋香濃，刀削冰不易融化；攤前常排隊。週一、四公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Taro balls several times the normal size, soft outside, chewy inside and full of taro flavour. The hand-shaved ice melts slowly. Often a line. Closed Mondays and Thursdays.

通化臨江街夜市16家美食（食尚玩家，2026）

stalls.summaryZh: 地瓜球Q彈有嚼勁、芋頭球內餡扎實，價格很便宜；只有一口油鍋，生意太好常要取號等候，建議先預訂。
stalls.summaryEn: Chewy sweet potato balls and dense taro balls at very low prices. There is only one fryer, so you often need to take a number and wait. Ordering ahead helps.

stalls.summaryZh: 臭豆腐炸得外酥內嫩、臭味不嗆，配蒜泥醬與泡菜清爽不膩；另有麻辣臭豆腐和臭臭鍋可選。
stalls.summaryEn: Stinky tofu fried crisp outside and soft inside, with a mild smell, served with garlic sauce and pickled cabbage so it does not feel greasy. Spicy stinky tofu and stinky tofu hot pot are also on the menu.

通化臨江街夜市16家美食（食尚玩家，2026）

stalls.summaryZh: 台式平價日料攤，現煮關東煮湯頭鮮甜，豆皮壽司和馬鈴薯沙拉是懷舊人氣款；生意好所以食材新鮮。週一公休。
stalls.summaryEn: A cheap Taiwanese-style Japanese stall. The oden broth is light and sweet, and the inari sushi and potato salad are nostalgic favourites. Busy enough that ingredients stay fresh. Closed Mondays.

stalls.where: 通化街 39 巷 50 弄 35 號（金興發巷內）
stalls.summaryZh: 現點現炸、皮薄酥脆，價格只要銅板價，熱門品項很早賣完，總是要排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: Fried to order with a thin, crisp coating at very low prices. Popular items sell out early, and there is always a line.

通化臨江街夜市16家美食（食尚玩家，2026）

stalls.summaryZh: 炭烤串燒刷甜鹹醬汁、火候精準，很多人願意等；點完通常要等 20–40 分鐘才拿得到。
stalls.summaryEn: Charcoal-grilled skewers brushed with a sweet-savoury sauce and cooked with precise heat. Many people happily wait, usually 20 to 40 minutes after ordering.
